summary: Module utilities hold shared code used by multiple modules, such as URL parsing, and can only be written in Python or PowerShell.
questions: What language can module utilities be written in?

answer_card.title: Module utilities
answer_card.answer_md: Shared code for multiple modules (e.g. `lib/ansible/module_utils/url.py`). You can write your own, but only in **Python or PowerShell**.
